listing.name: Saints Row (Saints Reborn)
listing.summary: Upstream route: SaintsReborn-Setup.exe fetches compiler/tools, imports own game and builds locally, creating play/update shortcuts. Setup or UpdateSaintsReborn owns replacement; identity is rename ofSaintsRowPC, not a new port. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream claims start-to-finish story/side missions/free roam. Multiplayer issues remain. SaintsRowPC rename preserves identity and updates. Renamed SaintsRowPC to SaintsReborn with existing updates preserved, not a new implementation. Setup downloads toolchain/builds locally; upstream full-playable claim with multiplayer caveats. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 local compiler setup. Linux setup is explicitly coming soon; framework portability is not player coverage. Original data: Xbox 360 Saints Row 2006 own disc. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
